decisions.topic: Presentation timeline drag out of bounds
decisions.legacyBehaviour: PresentationTimeline.update refuses (start<0, end>durationUs, end<=start, track kind mismatch): no updateDrag, banner "Déplacement refusé", cancelDrag on release
decisions.ownerBehaviour: PresentationTimelineEditingController.updateDrag/finishDrag clamp the delta and emit a command

decisions.legacyBehaviour: 2D handle rounds to whole cells (round(point+delta/cell)); 3D scene keeps the fractional part (point + integer cell delta) and reports clicks at cell centre +.5
decisions.ownerBehaviour: Both preserved unchanged as two functions (cinematicGridDragDestination, cinematicSpatialDragDestination); unify only on a product decision

decisions.topic: Initial playback camera window: Studio vs Player
decisions.legacyBehaviour: 2D preview clamps the window to min(15,w) x min(11,h); 3D preview uses a fixed 15x11
decisions.ownerBehaviour: Preserved via clampToMap; cinematics_ui10_preview_runtime_parity_test uses a fixed 15x11 on a large map, so a Studio/Player divergence on small maps is not checked

decisions.topic: Duplicated range validation with different messages
decisions.legacyBehaviour: Inspector refuses jump duration outside 200..30000, height outside (0,4], duration <=0, with its own French messages
decisions.ownerBehaviour: map_core (canonical) also validates jump ranges with ArgumentError; controller.updateDuration says "La durée doit être strictement positive." The Studio rules are now in the owner but still duplicate map_core; map_core not touched

decisions.legacyBehaviour: Inspector refuses non-finite, negative, > max (1 for intensity/volume) and non-integer ms
decisions.ownerBehaviour: Now enforced by the Studio owner (parseCinematicCommandNumber). Not checked whether map_core updateCinematicTimelineCommandStep rejects intensity 2 by itself (canonical package, not touched)

decisions.legacyBehaviour: The "Nouvelle présentation" button is disabled while busy
decisions.ownerBehaviour: PresentationWorkspaceController._create has no re-entrancy refusal: a second create bumps _generation and the first one returns false

decisions.topic: Crossing toggle shown only for 3D projects
decisions.legacyBehaviour: StudioToggleRow allowMobileActorCrossing offered only when project.settings.dimension == threeD
decisions.ownerBehaviour: The owner accepts the edit in any dimension; the display rule was left in the UI (not extracted)
